d: A look at a champion golfer at the world's pre-eminent Major, The Open. Here, look at the achievements of Scotsman Sandy Lyle, who was victorious at Royal St George's in 1985.
Follow the remarkable golf story of Australia's Ian Baker-Finch, most famous for his surprise win at The 1991 Open Championship at Royal Birkdale.
A look back at some of the best contests at The Open in years gone by. Here, a look at The 2013 Open at Muirfield, which concluded with a memorable final round comeback.
Gary Newbon talks to former West Indies bowler Joel Garner about his prolific cricketing career. Garner appeared in 58 tests between 1977 and 1987, taking an impressive 259 wickets.
Former England captain Casey Stoney discusses the individuals that have inspired her during her life and career.
Scottish golfer and Major champion Catriona Matthew looks at the personalities that have inspired her in her career.
In a special edition of My Icon to mark International Women's Day, former England cricket captain Charlotte Edwards looks at the personalities that have inspired her in her career.
Brighton and Hove Albion manager Chris Hughton discusses the individuals that have inspired him during his life and career.
Former Charlton and England star Chris Powell talks about the individuals that have inspired him over the course of his career.
British athlete and Olympic gold medallist Christine Ohuruogu speaks about the individuals who have inspired her over the course of her life.
British Para athlete Dan Bethell, who plays Para-Badminton for Team GB, talks about the individuals that have inspired him on his journey in the sport.
Former British sprinter Darren Campbell discusses the key individuals that have inspired him throughout his career.
A look back at some of the best contests at The Open in years gone by. Here, the 1992 Open at Muirfield, where Nick Faldo was going for his third Open title.
Look back at the career of Louis Oosthuizen, one that is defined by his 2010 success at St Andrews, becoming the fourth South African golfer to win The Open Championship.
